profile.subtitleJa: コラ人の門衛を務めた家系の祖先
profile.summaryJa: シャルムの父系はコレ、エビアサフ、コラと続きます。彼らの家は幕屋の門を守る務めを担ったと記されています。

facts.textJa: 門衛の組分けでは、コラ人メシェレミヤの子としてコレが記されています。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.
For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
